fusions.name: Reel and Rip
fusions.desc: Hooks the target with a barbed line and rips it free, dealing 16 piercing damage and using up every affliction you have on it for 60% more damage each. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds after.

fusions.name: Barbed Scratch
fusions.desc: A scratch that deals 4 piercing damage, leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds and slows it by 10% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Snare Line
fusions.desc: Lays a snare line 5 tiles long for 5 seconds that drags every enemy near it inward. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Wrong End of It
fusions.desc: Against an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, your dodge chance rises by 10%.
